alex: FYI hitting a nasty parse regression in streaming fncall flow when json_mode + union schema. Logs below.
priya: Oof. Which SDK/sample?
alex: python samplekit 0.11.0, using streaming=true + json_mode. Schema is `oneOf: [ {type: 'object', required: ['a']}, {type: 'array', items: {type: 'object'}} ]`. Works normally but after a 429 retry the stream chunks concatenate and we get `{"a":1}{"a":2}` in one chunk -> helper attempts JSON.parse on whole chunk -> throws.
toni: I've seen concatenated ndjson/chunked streams before. Do we handle ndjson? Our helper expects a single JSON value or a single array.
alex: Exactly. The retrier merges chunks when replaying partial stream; it replays buffered bytes as one payload instead of respecting original framing. See snippet:

```
# server stream chunk sequence (good):
{"a":1}
---chunk boundary---
{"a":2}

# after 429 retry replay (bad):
{"a":1}{"a":2}
```

priya: Workaround: set `streaming: false` or change schema to always be an array. Not great for customers who rely on per-item events.
toni: Could we make the streaming JSON helper detect ndjson and split on `}\n{` boundaries before parsing? Also try a lenient parse that attempts to decode multiple top-level JSONs.
qa: Repro steps I used: 1) start local mock server that responds 2 chunks then 429 on ack, 2) client stream with retry enabled, 3) observe combined chunk on retry. I can paste the mock server code in PR.
alex: Minimal repro attached to issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/449 (includes harness and logs).
priya: Proposed fix: a) auth/retry layer must preserve chunk boundaries when buffering streams for replay, b) sdk streaming parser should fallback to ndjson splitting when encountering parse errors and `oneOf` includes "array or object" kinds.
toni: I'll own streaming parser changes (add ndjson fallback + test). Priya, can you check the retry buffer logic?
priya: Yep, I'll look at the retrier buffer behavior. If we can't preserve boundaries cheaply, we'll at least mark the buffer as raw-chunks and re-send as multipart chunked stream instead of single string.
qa: Can we add a unit test that injects chunk boundary collapse so we don't regress? I'll add an integration test that simulates the 429 spike.
alex: Thanks. Customer impacted: internal staging job that consumes streaming fncall outputs; they're blocked from onboarding. I've told them ETA update tomorrow.
toni: Quick hack for customers: set `json_mode: 'ndjson'` if you can, we'll document this until we ship fix.
priya: Filing PRs: retrier change by EOD, streaming parser ndjson-fallback by tomorrow.
build-bot: CI queued for branch/stream-fix-2345.
qa: I'll run the new tests against the samplekit matrix once PRs land.
alex: Appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
